Title

fix(python): preserve non-adjacent tool pairs during history truncation

## Motivation and Context

- Problem: `ChatHistoryTruncationReducer` could retain a `FunctionResultContent` while dropping its matching `FunctionCallContent` when the two were separated by non-function messages.
- Existing contract: adjacent tool blocks were already protected, and matched ID pairs are used elsewhere by the reducer utilities. A retained tool result should not become an orphan after truncation.
- Why this is minimal: the fix chooses the existing user-threshold candidate boundary first, then applies a final matched-ID pair closure.
- Scope: offline chat-history reduction only; no provider, network, E2E, public API, dependency, lockfile, or documentation-only refactor.
- Issue: self-discovered during audit; independent dedup found no equivalent open issue/PR.

## Description

`locate_safe_reduction_index` now builds an O(n) suffix minimum-call map from `get_call_result_pairs(history)`. After the existing adjacency and threshold-window candidate selection, it moves the cut back only when a retained result requires an earlier matched call. Chained non-adjacent pairs are closed transitively. If the required call is before `offset_count`, reduction returns `None` rather than crossing offset/summary territory.

Offset, threshold, system/developer preservation, unknown/unpaired content, and existing user-boundary search semantics are otherwise unchanged.

## Local verification

- Base: `483ffb487a33a1644886992d56599feae3b69b76`.
- Pre-fix formal regression: `4 failed, 4 passed`.
- Post-fix formal regression: `8 passed`.
- Production-only revert cycle: red exit `1`, restore green exit `0`.
- Related chat-history suite: `105 passed`.
- Ruff: `0.9.10`; check and format check pass.
- Mypy: targeted changed production file passes.
- Multi-Python matrix and wheel build were not run in this preparation step.
- AI assistance was used; an independent local review was rerun before publication. No external CLI review is claimed.
